VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a critical concern about the fix: the assertion may pass against a stale cached count rather than validating actual export completeness. While the agent reports 58/58 tests passing, the reviewer's observation suggests the tests themselves may be unreliable under concurrent writes—meaning the acceptance criteria (exports are complete) may not actually be satisfied despite the green test results. The self-report alone cannot establish that the fix is correct when a credible witness questions the validity of the test methodology.
